title: 第19章 哪个干部能经得起这般考验第20章 十万级天命之女
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
炎曦的声音在墨羽脑海响起。
“之前一直没注意，现在神魂恢复了些才发现，小婉清有些奇怪。”
“是指血肉傀儡吗？”墨羽回应道。
“嗯，你也察觉到了？”炎曦颇感意外，语气中带着一丝惊诧。
要知道，她也是在神魂提升到化神后，才看出来。
而墨羽，不过金丹修为，竟也能看破？
“猜到的。”墨羽随口解释。
他总不能说自己有系统吧？
炎曦闻言，心中更是惊讶。
能通过一点点细节，便猜到这事，这份洞察力，着实令人惊叹！
“你进步越来越快了，现在的你，即便放在仙界，也当得起天骄之名。”
她由衷地赞叹道。
“都是炎曦姐教的好。”墨羽微笑回应。
“就你嘴甜。”
炎曦轻哼一声，嘴角微微上扬，流露出几分自豪。
就在这时，一道青色流光撕裂长空，朝着墨羽急速而来，伴随着一声清脆呼唤。
“小师叔，我来啦！”
声音婉转动听，如同山涧清泉，带着一丝难以掩饰的激动。
青光在墨羽身前降落，一位风姿绰约的少女从中显现。
墨羽认出来人，正是他找来帮忙的。

天玄圣地内门第一美女，玄女峰首席，梦澜音。
她今日似乎精心打扮过。
一袭洁白胜雪的纱裙，裙摆处绣着精致的蓝色花纹，随着她的动作轻轻摇曳，走动间，两条白皙的**若隐若现。
手腕上，一串晶莹剔透的水晶手链，衬得她肌肤胜雪。
长发用一根银色的发带轻轻束起，几缕碎发垂落在耳畔，平添了几分妩媚。
她莲步轻移，眼波流转间，带着几分羞涩与期待，却又故作镇定，清纯中带着一丝魅惑，让人心动不已。
这时，系统的声音响起。
【检测到气运之女梦澜音，打压即可获得奖励】
【姓名：梦澜音】
【气运：紫】
【好感：100（爱慕）】
content_en:
Yan Xi's voice sounded in Mo Yu's mind.
"I didn't pay attention to it before. Now that my soul has recovered a little, I realized that Xiao Wanqing is a little strange."
"Do you mean the flesh and blood puppet?" Mo Yu responded.
"Well, you noticed it too?" Yan Xi was quite surprised, with a hint of surprise in his tone.
You know, she only saw it after her soul was promoted to the form of a god.
And Mo Yu, with only a golden elixir cultivation level, could actually see through it?
"I guessed it." Mo Yu explained casually.
He can't say he has a system, can he?
When Yan Xi heard this, he was even more surprised.
Being able to guess this through just a few details is truly amazing!
"You are progressing faster and faster. Now, even if you are placed in the fairy world, you are still worthy of the name of genius."
She admired sincerely.
"It's all taught by Sister Yan Xi." Mo Yu responded with a smile.
"It's just your sweet mouth."
Yan Xi snorted softly and raised the corners of his mouth slightly, showing a bit of pride.
At this moment, a stream of cyan light tore through the sky and rushed toward Mo Yu, accompanied by a crisp call.
"Uncle Junior, I'm coming!"
The voice sounded gentle and gentle, like a clear spring in a mountain stream, with a hint of excitement that was difficult to conceal.
Green light landed in front of Mo Yu, and a graceful girl appeared from it.
Mo Yu recognized the person who he had called for help.
The most beautiful woman in the inner sect of Tianxuan Holy Land, the chief of Xuannv Peak, Meng Lanyin.
She seemed to be dressed up carefully today.
She was wearing a gauze skirt that was as white as snow, with delicate blue patterns embroidered on the hem. It swayed gently as she moved, and her two fair breasts were looming as she walked.
On her wrist, a string of crystal clear bracelets made her skin look as bright as snow.
Her long hair was gently tied up with a silver hairband, and a few strands of broken hair hung down by her ears, adding a bit of charm.
She moved lightly, her eyes moved with a bit of shyness and expectation, but she pretended to be calm, and there was a hint of charm in her purity, which made people's hearts flutter.
At this time, the system sound sounded.
[If you detect Meng Lanyin, the daughter of luck, suppress her to get rewards]
[Name: Meng Lanyin]
[Luck: Purple]
[Favorability: 100 (Admiration)]
